tiers.text: 9 of 15 registers have no recovered freeze condition
the flops form 1 register groups; the largest is reg_dfstp_2_1 (15 members)
success is driven by one flop (dfrtp_2_12); its D cone has 8 leaves

Recover the transition relation before you drive anything: for each of the nine state flops, evaluate its D under each of the four symbols with that flop's own state asserted. Thirty-six evaluations give you a graph, and the question is then which of its states can reach flop 8 -- three of them cannot reach anything outside themselves. Then read the success cone rather than assuming what it says: it names the counter as well as the state.
